en.name: Maple syrup, unopened plastic
en.summary: An unopened plastic bottle or jug of genuine maple syrup keeps 2 years in the cupboard, or 18–24 months refrigerated. The plastic is why this figure is shorter than the glass one: it lets a little oxygen through, and flavour drifts before anything unsafe happens.
en.pantry: Sealed in plastic, in a cool, dark, dry cupboard, it keeps 2 years. Plastic is slightly permeable to oxygen in a way glass is not, so the syrup slowly darkens and the flavour rounds off towards caramel even with the cap untouched — this is a quality limit rather than a safety cliff. Keep the jug upright and away from the hob and the window; warmth speeds all of that up. Crystals settling at the bottom of an old jug are sugar coming out of solution, not spoilage.
en.fridge: Refrigerating the unopened jug at 4 °C (40 °F) or below gives 18–24 months and, more to the point, holds the colour and flavour steady while it waits. Once the seal is broken the fridge stops being optional: genuine maple syrup is dilute enough for surface mould and yeast to grow, so an opened jug lives in the refrigerator with the cap tight, and gets poured and put straight back rather than left standing warm on the table.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is published for unopened maple syrup. Freezing is a reasonable way to hold a large quantity — the syrup thickens and goes sluggish rather than setting solid — and plastic, unlike glass, will take the expansion, though a full jug can still split at the seam. Leave headspace, and expect to stand the container in warm water before you can pour.
en.thawing: Move frozen syrup to the fridge, then stand the container in warm water until it pours. Do not microwave a sealed jug.
spoilage: Mould on the surface or growing around the neck and inside the cap.
A fermented, winey or yeasty smell instead of clean caramel.
Cloudiness or fine threads suspended in the syrup.
A jug that has swollen or fizzes when the cap is loosened.
tips: Buy the size your household will finish; plastic does not hold flavour as long as glass.
Keep it upright in a dark cupboard, not next to the cooker.
Refrigerate the moment it is opened.
Leave headspace if you freeze it — syrup expands and a full jug can split.

faq.q: How long does maple syrup in a plastic bottle keep unopened?
faq.a: 2 years in a cool dark cupboard, or 18–24 months refrigerated at 4 °C (40 °F) or below.

faq.q: Why does plastic keep maple syrup for less time than glass?
faq.a: Plastic lets a little oxygen through, so the syrup darkens and the flavour drifts sooner. It is a quality difference, not a safety one.

faq.q: Does opened maple syrup have to go in the fridge?
faq.a: Yes. It is dilute enough to grow surface mould at room temperature, so refrigerate it with the cap tight once the seal is broken.

zh.name: 楓糖漿（塑膠瓶未開封）
zh.summary: 未開封的塑膠瓶（壺）裝純楓糖漿，放櫥櫃可放 2 年，冷藏則是 18～24 個月。期限比玻璃瓶短的原因就在塑膠：它會透一點氧氣，風味會先走位，而不是先變得不安全。
zh.pantry: 塑膠瓶密封、放陰涼避光乾燥的櫥櫃，可放 2 年。塑膠對氧氣有一點透過性，這是玻璃沒有的問題，所以即使瓶蓋沒動過，糖漿也會慢慢變深、風味往焦糖那一側收攏——這是品質上限，不是安全懸崖。瓶子直立放，遠離爐台與窗邊，溫度會把上面這些變化全部加速。放久的瓶底沉出糖晶，那是糖析出，不是壞掉。
zh.fridge: 未開封的瓶子冰在 4 °C 以下可放 18～24 個月，更重要的是，它能在等待期間把顏色和風味穩住。封條一破，冷藏就不再是選項：真正的楓糖漿夠稀，表面會長霉、長酵母，所以開封後的瓶子住冰箱、蓋子旋緊，倒完立刻冰回去，而不是放在餐桌上一路回溫。
zh.freezer: 未開封的楓糖漿沒有公布的冷凍期限。冷凍是保存大量糖漿的合理做法（它會變稠變遲滯，而不是結成硬塊），而且塑膠不像玻璃，還能吃下膨脹的量——但裝得太滿的瓶子仍可能從接縫裂開。請留下空間，並且要有心理準備：倒之前得先把容器泡溫水。
zh.thawing: 先移到冷藏，再把容器泡在溫水裡，直到可以倒出來為止。不要把密封的瓶子直接微波。
spoilage: 表面長霉，或瓶口與瓶蓋內側長霉。
聞起來有發酵味、酒味或酵母味，而不是乾淨的焦糖香。
糖漿變混濁，或懸浮出細細的絲狀物。
瓶身鼓脹，或旋開蓋子時有氣體衝出。
tips: 買家裡用得完的容量，塑膠留住風味的能力不如玻璃。
直立放在暗處櫥櫃，不要放在爐子旁邊。
要冷凍請留空間，糖漿會膨脹，裝滿的瓶子會裂。

faq.q: 塑膠瓶的楓糖漿未開封可以放多久？
faq.a: 陰涼避光的櫥櫃 2 年，或冷藏 4 °C 以下 18～24 個月。

faq.q: 為什麼塑膠瓶比玻璃瓶短？
faq.a: 塑膠會透一點氧氣，糖漿比較早變深、風味比較早走位。這是品質差異，不是安全問題。

faq.q: 開封後的楓糖漿一定要冰嗎？
faq.a: 要。它在室溫下夠稀，表面會長霉，所以封條一破就要旋緊蓋子放冷藏。
